controlModel.clientUseState: minecraft:consumable 3600s / bow animation / intentionally_empty sound supplies a 72000-tick use duration to vanilla clients
controlModel.start: CE behavior cancels the interact event (SUCCESS_AND_CANCEL) then calls Paper startUsingItem; cancelled interact packets do not stop the manually started use state
controlModel.onUseTickTicker: server ticker mirrors source onUseTick: trigger held stops on sneak/empty, automatic types fire each tick subject to cooldown; aim stops when not sneaking and applies SLOWNESS after 6 used ticks
controlModel.release: io.papermc.paper.event.player.PlayerStopUsingItemEvent: trigger marker clears without firing; sneaking release at >=6 ticks fires one aimed shot, otherwise reloads (empty click when dry)
controlModel.cooldownGroup: first use replaces the static CE group with reverie_dreams:lunar_weapon/<uuid>; later copies of the same stack keep their own source cooldown
controlModel.consumeGuard: PlayerItemConsumeEvent cancelled for lunar weapons so the 72000-tick use can never eat the gun
controlModel.entityInteraction: vanilla clients do not enter a using state on interact-entity, so a right-click on a living entity performs one immediate source action (shot or sneak reload) without hold-to-aim
controlModel.aimAttack: source fires an aimed shot from its own C2S LunarAimFirePacket while the client holds attack during aim; a vanilla client cannot send that packet, so the Paper port fires the aimed shot on release and does not synthesize an approximation

knownDifferences: The source 13-pixel ammo bar is rendered from item data every frame; a Paper item bar cannot be exposed independently, so the remaining rounds live in the PDC and the three-line lore instead.
XP-dependent tooltip lines are refreshed on item creation, shot, reload, level change and a 20-tick safety interval, not recomputed at render time.
A fresh CE gun still carries the static type cooldown group until its first server-side use, when it is replaced by a per-stack source-equivalent group.
BOW use animation is used while the trigger is held because vanilla clients need a consumable-backed use state; the source shows NONE after the first shot.
Vanilla clients do not send a release for interact-entity use, so entity targeting performs one immediate source action instead of hold-to-aim.
The source client's aim-attack C2S packet has no vanilla-client equivalent; firing while holding attack during aim is unavailable, and only the release shot is implemented.
Source advancement/stat triggers are not fired by the Paper port.
Recoil uses Paper setRotation; the exact client rotation packet timing is not reproduced.
Ammo visible tooltip preserves real rounds, but custom13pixel native item bar cannot be exposed as an independent Paper component; no false durability added to the non-damageable gun.
Bursts are transient and cleared on stop as source DelayedTask; active projectiles persist through the shared backend.
Player death freezes pending frame at death to avoid Bukkit CraftPlayer rebind moving an old source reference to respawn; corpse drift/internals differ.
Source custom advancement/stat triggers remain to be handled centrally.
